modern: Examine the quality of the form of an object, and detach it completely from its material part, and then contemplate it; then determine the time, the longest which a thing of this particular form is naturally made to last.
original: Examine into the quality of the form of an object, and detach it altogether from its material part, and then contemplate it; then determine the time, the longest which a thing of this peculiar form is naturally made to endure.
notification: Examine the quality of the form of an object, and detach it completely from its material part, and then contemplate it…
notification_original: Examine into the quality of the form of an object, and detach it altogether from its material part, and then contemplate it…

explained.summary: A method of looking at things: separate what something essentially is from the stuff it’s made of, study that, then ask how long a thing of its kind can last at most. It’s a way of cutting through appearances and seeing both what a thing really is and how temporary it is.
